parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.

parameters.name: EventScope
parameters.description: The dimension of the security event.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.

parameters.name: UserStatusList
parameters.description:
The list of statuses for security event statistics.
>By default, security event data in the **toBeConfirmed**, **confirmed**, and **actioned** statuses is included in the statistics.
